status.title: System Status & Backup Hub
status.subtitle: Monitor infrastructure service health, automated backup schedules, and create or restore encrypted database backup archives.
status.loading: Loading system health status and backup archives...
status.error: System status could not be loaded.

archives.title: Encrypted Database Backup Archives (AES-256)
archives.subtitle: Each archive contains a full InnoDB database dump, private attachments, manifest, and SHA-256 checksum. Click 'Restore' to roll back the system to that point in time.
archives.emptySubtitle: Click 'Create New Backup' or 'Upload Archive (.ZIP)' above to manage your database backups.
archives.snapshotsSubtitle: Automatic JSON safety snapshots generated prior to running data reset commands.

services.automationGuideDesc: To enable daily automated backups at {time} WIB, set BACKUP_SCHEDULE_ENABLED=true and BACKUP_ENCRYPTION_KEY in .env, then configure your server cron/Task Scheduler: php artisan schedule:run

dialog.createDesc: The system will export all database tables, copy private attachments, and encrypt them into a ZIP archive using AES-256.
dialog.passphraseOptionalHint: Server already has BACKUP_ENCRYPTION_KEY configured. Leave blank to use the default server key.
dialog.passphraseRequiredHint: Save this passphrase securely. You will need it when restoring or extracting the .zip archive.
dialog.deleteConfirmMsg: Are you sure you want to permanently delete backup archive {filename}?

upload.title: Upload External Backup Archive (.ZIP)
upload.desc: Select a Sekolario .zip backup archive from your computer to add it to the server's archive list. Once uploaded, you can restore it immediately.

restore.title: Restore Database & Attachments
restore.step1Badge: Step 1 of 2 — Verify Key & Preview Contents
restore.passphrasePlaceholder: Enter the encryption key used when this archive was created...
restore.passphraseHint: The system will verify the SHA-256 checksum and preview the archive manifest before touching the database.
restore.safetyBackupLabel: Automatically create a safety backup of the current state before overwriting the database (backup-pre-restore-*.zip)
restore.safetyBackupHint: Strongly recommended so your current data prior to restore remains safely recoverable.
restore.sessionPreservedNotice: Your current admin login session and access tokens will be automatically preserved so you will not be logged out after the restore completes.
restore.warningText: WARNING: Restoring this archive will replace all active database tables and private attachments with the data from this backup point.
restore.successRestore: Database and attachments successfully restored from {filename} ({duration}s).
